additions.statement: The graduated-license sponsor options are listed in preference order, beginning with the eligible parent arrangements described by the handbook.

The remaining sponsor preference list ranks a Delaware-appointed legal guardian or court-appointed custodian ahead of another suitable person approved by the Secretary of Transportation or Chief of Driver Services.
A driver licensed under the medical-review report must provide the DMV a new report each year by the end of the driver’s birthday month.
The requested re-examination requirements for retaining driving privileges include favorable medical reports and passing the DMV’s vision, knowledge and driving-skills examinations.
The requested re-examination process may also require a certified driver-rehabilitation evaluation or training.
